{
 "path": "programs/task-1a2cd721.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                i, j = q.popleft()
                cells.append((i, j))
                for ni, nj in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)):
                    if 0 <= ni < h and 0 <= nj < w and (ni,nj) not in seen and grid[ni][nj] == color:
                        seen.add((ni,nj)); q.append((ni,nj))
            r0=min(i for i,j in cells); r1=max(i for i,j in cells)
            c0=min(j for i,j in cells); c1=max(j for i,j in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2: continue
            perimeter = ([(r0,j) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(r1,j) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] +
                         [(i,c0) for i in range(r0+1,r1)] + [(i,c1) for i in range(r0+1,r1)])
            if len(cells) == len(perimeter) and all(grid[i][j] == color for i,j in perimeter):
                area = (r1-r0-1) * (c1-c0-1)
                fill = 2 if area % 2 == 0 else 7
                for i in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for j in range(c0+1,c1): out[i][j] = fill
    return out
"
}

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                i, j = q.popleft()
                cells.append((i, j))
                for ni, nj in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)):
                    if 0 <= ni < h and 0 <= nj < w and (ni,nj) not in seen and grid[ni][nj] == color:
                        seen.add((ni,nj)); q.append((ni,nj))
            r0=min(i for i,j in cells); r1=max(i for i,j in cells)
            c0=min(j for i,j in cells); c1=max(j for i,j in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2: continue
            perimeter = ([(r0,j) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(r1,j) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] +
                         [(i,c0) for i in range(r0+1,r1)] + [(i,c1) for i in range(r0+1,r1)])
            if len(cells) == len(perimeter) and all(grid[i][j] == color for i,j in perimeter):
                area = (r1-r0-1) * (c1-c0-1)
                fill = 2 if area % 2 == 0 else 7
                for i in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for j in range(c0+1,c1): out[i][j] = fill
    return out
